Frequently Asked Questions

settings.title: What types of wallpaper materials do you offer?
settings.content:
We offer a range of materials to fit both residential and commercial needs, including Peel & Stick Linen, Peel & Stick Canvas, Pre-Pasted Wallpaper, Suede Type II 20oz, and Terralon Smooth Type II. Peel & Stick options are great for DIY projects, Pre-Pasted is ideal for easy installation, and our Type II materials are designed for long-lasting durability in high-traffic commercial spaces.

Click here for more information about our materials.

settings.title: Can I order a custom wallpaper design or use my own artwork?
settings.content: Yes. You can choose from our curated pattern library or upload your own design, photo, or artwork. We’ll ensure your file is print-ready and scaled to fit your wall perfectly, giving you complete creative freedom.

settings.title: How do you ensure the wallpaper fits my wall perfectly?
settings.content: Simply measure the full width and height of each wall, including doors and windows. Our ordering system allows you to input exact dimensions, and we provide installation guides to ensure a seamless fit with minimal waste.

settings.title: Are the wallpapers durable and easy to maintain?
settings.content: Yes. Our commercial-grade materials are designed to withstand heavy use, while our residential wallpapers are washable and scuff-resistant. Most surfaces can be gently cleaned with a damp sponge or soft cloth, making maintenance simple.

settings.title: Can the wallpaper be removed without damaging the wall?
settings.content: It depends on the material. Peel & Stick wallpapers can be removed cleanly without damage, making them perfect for renters or temporary spaces. Pre-Pasted and Type II wallpapers are more permanent solutions, designed for long-term installations.
